title: The Shadows Lurking Behind the Scenes

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Halloween season is in full swing, and amidst the bustling Halloween Park, daily, many customers were coming to visit Tsumugi and the others' haunted house.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンシーズンも盛りとなり、
ハロウィンパークにはたくさんの人が訪れるなか、
ツムギたちのお化け屋敷にも連日たくさんのお客がやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Women 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Wowwwwwww!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわぁあああああああ！

text_block_list.name: Kid
text_block_list.text:
It seems like this haunted house is the talk of the town,
right here.
text_block_list.orig_text: 話題になってるお化け屋敷はここみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: A Girl
text_block_list.text: It looks fun! Let's go, hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しそう！
　早く行こう！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe their haunted house became this popular. 
It's a delightful miscalculation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかあいつらのお化け屋敷がここまで人気になるとは。
うれしい誤算だ。

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: Are you here for an inspection, guildmaster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
組合長、
視察ですかな？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Well, that's about it.
text_block_list.orig_text: まぁそんなところだ。

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text:
It's great to see that it's thriving. 
The number of people coming to Halloween Park has also reached a record high.
text_block_list.orig_text:
繁盛しているようで何よりですな。
ハロウィンパークへやって来る人の数も
過去最高を記録しておりますよ。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, that parade seems like it will be quite lively. 
My skills are tingling. I will make sure it's a parade that will never be forgotten.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぅ、
それはパレードも大いに賑わいそうだな。
腕が鳴るぜ。
絶対に忘れられないパレードにしてやるよ。

text_block_list.name: Town Mayor
text_block_list.text: Just a moment, there's something I'd like to discuss regarding that matter...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうど、
その件でちょっとご相談したいことが……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, good job in the morning session.
At this pace, it seems like we can break the record
for the number of attendees.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさん午前の部お疲れさまでした。
このペースで行けば
入場者の記録更新できそうですよ。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's amazing, it's so popular! 
And it's all thanks to Tsumugi and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！
　すごい、
大人気だね！
これもツムギちゃんたちのおかげだよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Because you all are working hard. 
We are only here to support. 
I really think today's response was amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちが頑張っているからですよ。
私たちはサポートでしかありません。
今日の対応なんて、
本当にすごくよかったと思います。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Did we do something like that?
text_block_list.orig_text: オレサマたちなんかしたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
When the child customer started crying,
Victor made them laugh, didn't he?
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どものお客さんが泣きだしてしまったときに、
ビクターが笑わせてあげていたじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Oh, that was just me tripping over because I was worried and trying to run over to you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれは心配で駆け寄ろうとしたら
転んじゃっただけだよ～

text_block_list.name: エディ
text_block_list.text: Ah! That was definitely funny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！
　確かにあれは笑えたな！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Matthew was amazing too. 
He quietly brightened up without leaving.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マシューも偉かったよ。
出ていかずにこっそり明るくしてあげて。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I wanted to leave,
but I thought if I suddenly left, it would scare them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当は出ていきたかったけど、
ボクがいきなり出ると
怖がらせちゃうと思って……

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: It's a strange story, even though the haunted house is supposed to be scary!
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖がらせるのがお化け屋敷なのに
変な話だよな！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right.
But at that time, I felt like something was different.
I wonder why.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよねー
でもあのときは、
なんか違うって思ったんだよね。
なんでかなー

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: From the part where you said you wanted to scare me, you've grown so much. It's nostalgic to think back to when we were running away from monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖がらせたいって言ってたところから、
すごい成長ッスよね。
魔物から逃げ回ってたときが懐かしいッス。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Now, I'll make the monsters scream too!
text_block_list.orig_text: 今なら魔物にも悲鳴をあげさせてやるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the screams of monsters are delicious~
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物の悲鳴って
おいしいのかな～

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem as tasty as the screams
from the haunted house, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お化け屋敷の悲鳴より
おいしくはなさそうだよねー

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Is the scream here really that delicious? 
Just listening to it makes me want to eat it too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここの悲鳴はそんなにおいしいんスか？
聞いてると
自分も食べたくなってくるッス……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that's delicious!
And it keeps getting better and better!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うめぇぜ！
　それもどんどんうまくなってくんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because we're gradually turning into scary ghosts, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレサマたちが
どんどん怖いお化けになってるってことじゃねぇかな！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
In our haunted house, if this is the case, 
other haunted houses must be even more delicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクたちのお化け屋敷でこれなら、
他のお化け屋敷はもっとおいしいんだろうなー

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Just when I thought they had grown up, they go and act like kids again... or rather, what should I even call them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
成長したと思ったら
またこの子たちらしいというか
なんというか……

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi? Did you say something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃん？
　なにか言った？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing at all. 
Well, then shall we take a break soon?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでもありません。
さて、
それじゃあそろそろ休憩に入りましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Alright! Well then, let's go play right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっしゃ！
　そんじゃあさっそく遊びに行こうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: I am tired, so I'm going to take a nap.
text_block_list.orig_text: オレサマは疲れたから昼寝するわー

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: I want to practice a little more, so I'll pass on today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクはもうちょっと練習したいから
今日はいいや。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, you're not very sociable, huh? Victor, you're coming with me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ付き合い悪いな―
ビクター、
おまえは一緒に来るだろ？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: I really want to go, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
行きたいけど、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Please keep an eye on Mister Eddie to make sure he doesn't play too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エディさんが遊び過ぎないように
見張ってあげてください。

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Yes! I understand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
うん！
　分かった！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! What's with that?
Well, whatever. Since Tsumugi gave her permission,
let's go, Victor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぇっ！
　なんだよそれ。
まぁいいや。
ツムギちゃんのお許しも出たし、
行こうぜビクター！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Ah~ Wait a minute~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
待ってよ～

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Well, let's see. Where should we go, I wonder?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ～て、
と。
どこ行こうかな～

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Oh, you shouldn't play too much, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
遊び過ぎは
ダメだからね。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I know, okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かってるって！

text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃーーーーーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Incredible scream...
text_block_list.orig_text: すごい悲鳴……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
I thought we had grown up too, but 
we've never caused a scream like that before. Let's go see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレたちも成長したと思ってたけど、
あんな悲鳴あげさせられたことねぇよな。
見に行こうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait for me~~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
待ってよ～～！

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is this the Ghost Father's haunted house?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　ここゴーストファーザーのお化け屋敷、
だよな？

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: That's right~
text_block_list.orig_text: そうだね～

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text:
Could it be Ghost Father? As expected!
Let's go ask for tips! Hey, Ghost Father! Are you there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひょっとしてゴーストファーザーが？
　さすがだな！
コツ聞きに行こうぜ！
おーい、
ゴーストファーザー！
　いるかー！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Ah, it's you guys. What do you want?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　ああ、お前らか。
何の用だ。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: I heard a really loud scream from over here, so I came to see what was happening. But the only ghost that can make such a scary scream is Ghost father, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちからすげぇ悲鳴が聞こえてきたから、
見に来たんだ。
でもあんな悲鳴あげさせられるお化けは、
ゴーストファーザーくらいしかいねぇよな！

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that scream. Well, it's a little something.
The mayor wanted to get a feel for the parade,
so I showed him a little rehearsal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
あの悲鳴か。
ありゃあ、
ちょっとな。
町長がパレードの雰囲気を知りたいってんで、
ちょっとした予行演習を見せてやったんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: After all, Ghost Father is amazing...
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱりゴーストファーザーはすげぇや……

text_block_list.text: U-Ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: Huh? That voice just now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　今の声……

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling okay? You seem a little troubled...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか苦しそう……
だいじょうぶ～？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
　おい！

text_block_list.name: Victor
text_block_list.text: What is this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに、
これ……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Damn it! Can't help it if I've been seen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ！
　見られちまったもんは仕方ねぇか。

text_block_list.name: Eddie
text_block_list.text: What... What are you talking about, Ghost Father...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何言ってるんだ、
ゴーストファーザー……

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Don't give up just because you had bad luck.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クククッ。
運が悪かったと諦めな。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Both of them are late, aren't they?
text_block_list.orig_text: 二人とも遅いね。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Anyway, Eddie is just fooling around.
text_block_list.orig_text: どうせエディが遊びほうけてるんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, even though I said so much.
When they come back,
I'm going to give them a scolding.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
あれだけ言ったのに。
帰ってきたらお説教ですね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You're not coming back, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text: 帰ってこないッスね。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Is there something wrong, or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かあった、
とかじゃないですよね？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Eddie aside, it's strange that Victor hasn't come back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エディはともかく、
ビクターが帰ってこないのはおかしいね。

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: You don't have to worry, they will come back soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな心配しなくても
そのうち帰ってくるだろ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
As Hughes said, I'll be back soon.
But I'm getting a little hungry,
so I'm going to buy some food.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒューズさんの言う通り、
そのうち帰ってきますよ。
でも私、
ちょっと空腹に耐えられそうにないので、
ご飯買いに行ってきます。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Tsugumi...
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギ……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If you're worried, why don't you just say so?
text_block_list.orig_text: 心配ならそう言えばいいじゃないッスか。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not like that! I'm just really hungry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなんじゃないですよ！
　
本当にお腹が空いただけです！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Shall we all go buy some food together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうことにして
みんなでご飯を買いに行こうか。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: That's right! Let's go look for the two of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね！
　二人を探しに行こう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Matthew, if you say that, it'll be obvious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マシューさん、
それを言ったらおしまいッス。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, my goodness! Alright, I'm going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！
　いいから行きますよ！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: There's no one here, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: どこにも居ないね。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You went to all the stalls, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text: 出店は全部回ったッスよね？

text_block_list.name: Hughes
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's how it's supposed to be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そのはずだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Where on earth are those kids wandering around?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったくあの子たち、
どこほっつき歩いてるんですかね。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, young ladies. 
What are you doing in a place like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
嬢ちゃんたち。
こんなところでどうしたンだい？

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Eddie and Victor went out to buy lunch and haven't come back yet. Ghost Father, have you seen them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エディとビクターがお昼を買いに行って帰ってきてないんだ。
ゴーストファーザー、
二人を見なかった？

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? No, I didn't see them.
If I see them, I'll call out to them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　いや、見てねぇなぁ。
見かけたら声を掛けておこう。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but thank you in advance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませんが、
よろしくお願いします。

text_block_list.name: Ghost Father
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me.
text_block_list.orig_text: 任せときな。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Due to circumstances,
the haunted house is temporarily closed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません、
すみません。
事情によりお化け屋敷は臨時休業中なんです……

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I was looking forward to it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ、
楽しみにしてたのにー

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. Let's go to the other haunted house.
Isn't that one more famous originally?
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないよ。
もう一つのお化け屋敷に行こう。
あっちの方がもともと有名じゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose there's no helping it,
so let's do it that way, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
仕方ないからそうしましょうか。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Where did the two of them go... Everyone has been searching for them, but they can't be found...
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人ともどこ行っちゃったんでしょう……
みんなずっと探してくれているのに見つからないなんて……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: No good. They're really not anywhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだ。
やっぱりどこにも居ない。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: We were no good either...
text_block_list.orig_text: ボクたちもダメだった……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Then we can only hope for Kishi-san and Matsuri...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですか。
あとは騎士さんとマツリさんに期待するしか……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
I've been investigating with {0} in town!
We've found two clues!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんと一緒に
町の人たちに聞き込みしてきたッス！
二人の手がかりを見つけたッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Really?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 本当ですか！？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
That's a strange story, 
They say they saw them with Ghost Father.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがおかしな話で、
ゴーストファーザーと一緒に居るところを見たって言うんスよね。

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean by that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　それってどういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You should just ask them directly. Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなの直接聞けばいいんです。
行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Matthew
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
うん！
　行こう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After Tsumugi, who was worried about the two of them, began to walk, everyone followed suit at once.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人の身を案じ歩きだしたツムギのあとに、
皆も一斉に続くのであった。
